## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `./gradlew :composeApp:assembleDebug`
- [ ] `./gradlew :composeApp:testDebugUnitTest`
- [ ] Documentation updated when behavior/architecture changed
- [ ] No secrets, signing files, private data, or unlicensed reference assets added

## Notes

Call out anything intentionally deferred to `ROADMAP.md` instead of presenting incomplete work as production-ready.
